title: Ordinary scalar transpose of the supported coefficient unit is invertible
statement: Let a:Lambda -> Lambda-prime be a map of commutative condensed ring objects, and let Y have Noetherian diagonal surface W. If v is a regular-module semilinear map on P=ProjectiveLine Y with underlying coefficientMap a P, then the ordinary extendRestrictAdjunction on W sends supportMap a Y v under its inverse Hom equivalence to an isomorphism from ordinary extension of source Lambda Y to source Lambda-prime Y. These maps and sources are those of def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints. This assertion has no derived functors or normalized trace-source data.

source.place: Paragraph (1), closed diagonal supported coefficient source; supported-source normalization in the diagonal tower trace

proof.text: Apply the existing proved closed_scalar_iso helper of CondensedLocallyClosedScalarExtension to the diagonal and its open complement. The complement is quasi-compact since the surface is Noetherian. It says the actual canonical pushHom scalar/direct-image mate is invertible for every module, without a flatness assumption. Its proof uses closed counits, zero open restrictions, the scalar/pullback conjugate and open/closed joint reflection.

Use the proved regular-module unitComparisonIso and unitComparison_unit of ScalarExtensionMonoidal. The isomorphism from extension of the regular module to the new regular module has adjoint transpose with underlying sheaf map coefficientMap a. The supplied equality on v and faithfulness of forgetting the module action identify this transpose with v.

The unit identity for inverse mates, followed by naturality of the restriction/direct-image square, shows that pushHom at the regular module followed by direct image of the regular-module comparison has scalar adjunct lowerStar.map v followed by comapLowerStarIso.inv. This is definitionally supportMap. Injectivity of the scalar Hom equivalence identifies its inverse transpose with that composite. Both factors are invertible, proving the theorem. This argument uses no nonzero-coefficient or inhabited-scheme assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_supported_ordinary_scalars
    {Λ Λ' : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj Λ'] [IsCommMonObj Λ']
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (v : Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟶
      (Mod.comap (coefficientMap a (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ' (ProjectiveLine Y))))
    (_hv : v.hom = coefficientMap a (ProjectiveLine Y)) :
    IsIso (((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction (coefficientMap a (diagonalSurface Y))).homEquiv
        _ _).symm (supportMap a Y v))
